wire.sessions.approval_stop_local: stop {address} if it is idle: releases the session lease and never signals; refused while it is working
wire.sessions.approval_stop_peer: stop {address} on {peer}: always refused on this build, nothing will be sent
wire.sessions.stop_pending: stop accepted by "{name}", but it had not exited after {seconds} s. No signal was sent — read the session list before retrying.
wire.sessions.stop_refused_busy: "{name}" is working right now (a turn, an approval, a subagent or a job), so nothing was stopped and no signal was sent. Try again once it is idle.
wire.sessions.stop_refused_old_owner: "{name}" runs an older build that cannot promise an idle-only stop, so nothing was stopped and no signal was sent. Retrying will not change that — ask the operator to stop it.
wire.sessions.stop_refused_unanswered: "{name}" did not answer, so an idle-only stop could not be confirmed and no signal was sent. Read the session list first — it may already be gone.
wire.sessions.stop_refused_wake: "{name}" is idle, but a scheduled wake is due inside the hold window, so nothing was stopped and no signal was sent. Try again after that wake has fired.
wire.sessions.stop_remote_refused: A session on another device cannot be stopped from here on this build: no idle-only, no-signal exit can be guaranteed, so nothing was sent. The operator can stop it on that device.
wire.sessions.stop_self_refused: That target is this session, and a session cannot stop itself. Stop it from another session.
